steps.title: Register with your clan code
steps.body: Your clan leader gives you the code.

steps.title: Your leader approves you
steps.body: Only real members of the clan can see its fund.

steps.title: Every Kip is accounted for
steps.body: Contributions, slips and outstanding amounts in one place.

story.footer: Funeral mutual-aid fund management for Lao clans.

login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use the phone number you registered with.

register.title: Join your clan
register.lede: With a clan code, your clan leader reviews your registration. Without one you can register now and see donation requests only.
register.clanCodeHint: Ask your clan leader for this code. No code yet? Leave it empty — you can add it later.
register.phoneHint: You will sign in with this number.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number (8–15 digits).
errors.birthInvalid: Enter a real date of birth.
errors.docNumberRequired: Enter the number on the document.
errors.expiryBeforeIssue: The expiry date is before the issue date.

auth.badCredentials: That phone number and password don't match. Check both and try again.
auth.pending: Your registration is waiting for your clan leader's approval. You can sign in once they approve it.
auth.rejected: Your clan leader declined this registration. Contact them if you think this is a mistake.
auth.disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact your clan leader.
auth.clanDisabled: Your clan's account is currently disabled. Contact your clan leader.
auth.unknownClan: No clan uses this code. Ask your clan leader for it.
auth.clanInactive: This clan isn't accepting registrations right now.
auth.phoneTaken: This phone number is already registered. Sign in instead.
auth.registered: Registration sent to {clan}. Your clan leader needs to approve it before you can sign in.
auth.registeredNoClan: Your account is ready. Sign in to see donation requests. You can add a clan code later from your account.

admin.title: Platform overview
admin.lede: Create and switch clans on or off, and set the fee taken from each funeral collection. Clan funds are managed by each clan's leader.
admin.noClansBody: Create the first clan and its leader account with the form beside this list.
admin.leaderVerifiedHint: Only general users with an approved identity document, not yet in a clan. They sign in again as Clan Leader.
admin.leaderNoCandidates: No verified user is free to lead a clan yet. Approve someone's identity document first, or create a new account.
admin.leaderNotEligible: This person can no longer be chosen: they must be a verified general user with no clan.
admin.tempPasswordHint: Share it with the leader privately.
admin.clanCreated: {clan} created. {leader} can now sign in with {phone}.
admin.codeTaken: Another clan already uses this code.
admin.phoneTaken: This phone number is already registered.
admin.feeHint: Deducted from total donations and paid to the platform account.
admin.noFees: No fees yet. A fee is recorded when a clan closes a collection or pays a Mode A payout.
admin.savingsFeeHint: Owed by each round's receiver. A group keeps the rate it started with.

clan.lede: Approve new members and look after your clan's roster.
clan.clanCodeNote: Share this with relatives so they can register.
clan.contributionNote: Fixed for every event. Changing it needs uploaded meeting minutes.
clan.modeABody: Members contribute to the central fund in advance; payouts come from the fund.
clan.modeBBody: The fund starts at 0 ₭; each reported death sends a collection bill to every member.
clan.noneWaiting: No one is waiting. New registrations with code {code} will appear here.
clan.noMembersBody: Approved members will be listed here.
clan.noneJoining: Nobody is asking to join. Someone who registered without a clan code can send {code} from their account to appear here.

member.lede: You are a member of {clan}. Your contributions and family details will be kept here.
member.name: Name
member.upToDate: You are up to date. Each funeral event asks {amount} per person
member.modeASuffix: , paid from the clan's central fund.
member.modeBSuffix: , collected when the event is reported.
member.familyBody: Add your spouse, children or parents so they are covered. {n} added so far.
member.slipsBody: Upload proof of payment when a case is called.
member.historyBody: Every contribution you made and anything still owed.
member.upToDateA: You are up to date. You save {amount} into the clan's central fund; funeral payouts come from that fund.
member.owesBody: {open} for open collections and {debt} earlier debt. Please pay your clan leader.
member.noOpen: No collection is open right now.

settings.title: Fund settings
settings.lede: Changing the fund mode or rate needs a joint meeting. Upload the signed minutes and the new setting applies to every event from then on.
settings.amountHintA: What each member saves per period, in whole Kip.
settings.amountHintB: What each member pays per funeral event, in whole Kip. For example 150000.
settings.minutesHint: Photo or PDF of the signed minutes, up to 5 MB.
settings.notePlaceholder: e.g. Agreed at the annual meeting
settings.saved: Saved. Version {n} applies from now on.
settings.amountInvalid: Enter a whole amount in Kip, from 1,000 to 100,000,000.
settings.periodRequired: Choose monthly or yearly for Mode A.
settings.meetingDateInvalid: Enter the meeting date. It can't be in the future.
settings.minutesType: Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
settings.minutesSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
settings.noChange: This is the same as the current setting.
settings.noHistory: No changes yet. The clan is on its starting setting (version 1).

family.title: Family members
family.lede: Add the people in your household who are covered by the clan fund: your spouse, children and parents.
family.emptyBody: Add your spouse, children or parents so they are covered.
family.relationshipRequired: Choose how they are related to you.
family.dobInvalid: Enter a real date of birth. It can't be in the future.

account.title: Your account
account.lede: Change the password you use to sign in. Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out.
account.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
account.joinBody: Have a clan code? Send it to that clan's leader. Once they approve you, you become a member and see your clan's fund, events and payments.
account.joinHint: Ask the clan leader for this code.
account.joinSent: Sent to {clan}. Their leader needs to approve it.
account.joinAlready: You already have a request waiting.

reset.note: Give it to them in person. They can change it under Account after signing in.

events.title: Event list
events.lede: Report a death to start a collection. The rate is locked for each event and can't be changed later.
events.emptyBody: When a member or a member's family passes away, report it here.
events.newLedeB: A bill for {amount} goes to every member account at once. The rate is locked for this event.
events.newLedeA: The payout will come from the clan's central fund after a treasurer approves it.
events.notePlaceholder: e.g. Funeral at the family home
events.errDate: Enter the date of death. It can't be in the future.
events.errAlready: This person has already been reported.
events.errState: This event has changed. Refresh the page and try again.
events.closeBody: Unpaid bills become outstanding debt that is added to each member's next bill. Then the platform fee of {pct}% is deducted.
events.closeConfirm: Close now? {n} unpaid bills will become debt.
events.cancelBody: You can cancel while no money has been recorded for this event.
events.cancelConfirm: Cancel this event? Its bills will be voided.
events.needsTreasurer: Assign at least one treasurer on the Overview page first. A treasurer must approve every payout.
events.available: The fund can cover up to {amount}.
events.feeOnPayout: A {pct}% platform fee is also taken from the fund when this is paid.
events.errAmount: Enter an amount in Kip that the fund can cover.
events.proofHint: Optional photo or PDF, up to 5 MB.
events.completedNote: This event is complete. Thank you for caring for the family.
events.yourBillUnpaid: Please pay {amount} to your clan leader.
events.yourBillCarried: Not paid before the collection closed; it is now part of your outstanding debt.
events.noBill: Your household has no bill for this event.

fund.title: Clan fund
fund.lede: Every Kip that comes in or goes out, in a ledger that can't be edited. Mistakes are fixed with a correcting entry.
fund.errNote: Describe what the money is for.

approvals.title: Payout approvals
approvals.lede: As treasurer you are the second person who checks every payout before the leader pays it.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
approvals.approved: Approved. The leader can now pay the family.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The leader has been shown your reason.
approvals.errFunds: The fund doesn't have enough money for this payout any more.

treasurer.none: No treasurer yet. Payouts need a treasurer's approval.

slips.title: Transfer slips to check
slips.lede: Members upload proof of their transfers here. Check each one against the bank account before approving.
slips.mismatch: The amount is different from what is expected.
slips.reasonPlaceholder: Required when rejecting, e.g. money not received
slips.rejected: Slip rejected. The member will see your reason.
slips.errState: This slip has already been handled. Refresh the page.
slips.errAlreadyPaid: This item is already paid. Reject the slip with a reason.
slips.fileHint: A clear photo or screenshot of the transfer, up to 5 MB.
slips.includeDebt: This transfer also covers my earlier debt ({amount})
slips.uploaded: Slip sent. Your clan leader will check it.
slips.errTarget: This item can't be paid by slip right now.
slips.errPending: A slip for this item is already waiting to be checked.
slips.errAmount: Enter the amount you transferred, in Kip.
slips.errDate: Enter the transfer date. It can't be in the future.
slips.errFile: Attach a photo or PDF of the slip.
slips.rejectedNote: Rejected: {note}. You can upload a new slip.

contributions.title: Savings contributions
contributions.lede: In Mode A each member saves {amount} {period} into the central fund. Open a period to create everyone's due.
contributions.notModeA: Contributions are for Mode A. Your clan is on Mode B; change it in Fund settings after a meeting if needed.
contributions.label: Period
contributions.errNotModeA: Contributions can only be opened in Mode A.

payments.title: My payments
payments.lede: What you owe, the slips you have sent, and everything you have paid.
payments.nothing: You are all paid up. Thank you.

reports.title: Account report
reports.lede: Income and expenses of the clan fund for any period, ready to share at meetings.
reports.noEvents: No funeral events in this period.
reports.outstandingBody: {amount} owed by {n} members (open bills, earlier debt and unpaid contributions).
reports.ledgerNote: Showing the latest {n}. The export includes every entry.
reports.noEntries: No money moved in this period.
reports.errRange: Choose a start date on or before the end date.
reports.adminLede: Statistics across all clans. Each clan's fund stays under its own leader.

donations.title: Donation requests
donations.lede: Members of every clan can ask for help here, and anyone can give. Money goes straight to the person who asked.
donations.emptyBody: When someone needs help with hospital bills, a fire or school fees, they can ask here.
donations.newLede: Explain what you need, and say where donors should transfer the money. Everyone in every clan will see this request.
donations.fTitle: What do you need help with?
donations.fTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Hospital bills for my father
donations.fStoryPlaceholder: A few sentences about the situation and what the money is for.
donations.fTargetHint: Optional. Leave empty if you don't have a fixed amount.
donations.fQrHint: Optional photo of your bank QR, up to 5 MB.
donations.errTitle: Give your request a short title.
donations.errStory: Explain the situation in a few sentences.
donations.errTarget: Enter an amount in Kip, or leave it empty.
donations.errDeadline: The date must be today or later.
donations.errPayment: Give at least an account name and number, or a QR photo, so people can send money.
donations.errFile: Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file, up to 5 MB.
donations.noPayment: No payment details were given. Contact the person directly.
donations.fSlipHint: Photo or PDF of the transfer, up to 5 MB.
donations.fAnonymous: Hide my name from other people
donations.sent: Thank you. {name} will confirm when the money arrives.
donations.errAmount: Enter the amount you sent, in Kip.
donations.errDate: Enter the transfer date. It can't be in the future.
donations.errSlip: Attach a photo or PDF of your transfer.
donations.errClosed: This request is closed and can't take new donations.
donations.noDonors: No donations yet. Be the first to help.
donations.pendingBody: Check each slip against your bank account before confirming.
donations.reasonPlaceholder: Required when rejecting, e.g. money not received
donations.confirmed: Donation confirmed. Thank you for keeping it up to date.
donations.rejected: Donation rejected. The donor will see your reason.
donations.errState: This donation has already been handled. Refresh the page.
donations.closeBody: Close the request when you have what you need. It stays visible, but no new donations can be added.
donations.closedNote: This request is closed. Thank you to everyone who helped.
donations.editLede: Change the details or the payment information. Everyone who already donated keeps their donation.
donations.keepFile: Leave empty to keep the current file.
donations.notYours: You can only edit your own request.
donations.shareHint: Anyone with the link can read the story and see how much has been raised. Your bank details stay hidden until they sign in.
donations.publicNote: Sign in with your clan account to see where to send money and to record your donation.
donations.publicFooter: Funeral mutual-aid fund management for Lao clans.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lede: Everything that happened in your clan and on your donations.
notifications.emptyBody: You will see new collections, approvals and donations here.

types.member_approved: Your clan leader approved your registration. Welcome to {clan}.
types.member_rejected: Your clan leader declined your registration.
types.event_new: New collection for {name}. Your household owes {amount}.
types.event_debt: Your unpaid bill for {name} is now a debt of {amount}.
types.slip_approved: Your transfer slip of {amount} was approved.
types.payout_requested: {name} asks to pay {amount} to the family. Your approval is needed.
types.period_opened: Savings for {label} are open. You owe {amount}.
types.donation_received: {name} sent {amount} to your request. Please confirm when it arrives.
types.donation_confirmed: {name} confirmed your donation of {amount}. Thank you.
types.treasurer_assigned: Your clan leader made you treasurer. You now approve payouts.
types.leader_assigned: You are now a leader of {clan}. Sign in again to open the leader pages.
types.join_requested: {name} is asking to join your clan.
types.join_approved: You are now a member of {clan}. Sign in again to see your clan's fund.
types.kyc_submitted: {name} sent an identity document to check.
types.kyc_approved: Your identity document was approved. You can now join a clan and ask for donations.
types.kyc_rejected: Your identity document was not accepted: {note}
types.kyc_revoked: Your identity document is being looked at again.
types.savings_join_request: {name} asks to join your savings group {group}.
types.savings_join_approved: You are in the savings group {group}.
types.savings_your_turn: {group}, round {round} is yours. You will receive {pot}.
types.savings_slip_uploaded: {name} sent a slip of {amount} for {group}. Please check it.
types.savings_slip_rejected: {name} did not accept your payment for {group}: {note}
types.savings_round_done: {group}, round {round} is complete. You received {pot}. Platform fee owed: {fee}.
types.savings_completed: {group} has finished. Every member has received their pot.
types.savings_swap_requested: {name} asks to swap turns with you in {group}.
types.savings_swap_done: {group}: {a} and {b} swapped turns. {a} now receives in round {ra}, {b} in round {rb}.
types.savings_swap_requested_note: {name} asks to swap turns with you in {group}: "{note}"

clansAdmin.title: Clans
clansAdmin.lede: Every clan on the platform. Search, filter, open a clan to see its people and fund, or create a new one.
clansAdmin.noLeaderBody: This clan has no leader. Open a member or a general user and make them clan leader.
clansAdmin.cardBody: Search clans, see each clan's people and fund, create and disable clans.

fundAdmin.title: Fund
fundAdmin.lede: Money across every clan, in totals only, the platform fee rate, and the fees clans owe.
fundAdmin.cardBody: Each clan's fund at a glance, and the platform fees to collect.

branding.title: System settings
branding.lede: How the app looks to everyone: its name, logo and colours.
branding.fundLede: The platform fee is a percentage of every collection a clan makes. A change applies to funerals reported from now on; ones already reported keep the fee they started with.
branding.appNameHint: Shown in the header, on the sign-in page and in the browser tab.
branding.logoHint: Square PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Leave empty to keep the current one.
branding.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 2 to 60 characters.
branding.logoInvalid: The logo must be a PNG, JPG or WebP image of 1 MB or less.

clanTypes.title: Clan types
clanTypes.lede: Group clans by type. Pick a type when creating a clan, or change it in the clan list.
clanTypes.name: Name
clanTypes.pick: Choose a clan type from the list.
clanTypes.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.
clanTypes.nameTaken: A clan type with this name already exists.
clanTypes.inUse: Clans still use this type. Retire it instead (Edit → untick In use).
clanTypes.failed: That change could not be made.

users.title: Users
users.lede: Every account on the platform. Open anyone to see their full details, block someone who should not get in, or delete an account that has no records.
users.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, email or clan code
users.protectedBody: A Super Admin account can't be blocked or deleted from here, so the platform can never be locked out of itself.
users.noHistory: Nothing has happened to this account yet.
users.manageBody: Blocking signs the person out immediately and stops them signing in again.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} for good? This cannot be undone.
users.deleteNote: Only an account with no records can be deleted. If this person has bills, slips, payouts or donations, block them instead.
users.deleteBlocked: This account has records that must be kept (bills, slips, payouts or donations), so it can't be deleted. Block it instead.
users.deleteFailed: That account could not be deleted.
users.deleteSuperAdmin: A Super Admin account can't be deleted.
users.newLede: Create an account for someone, for example a person who can't sign up on their own. It is active straight away.
users.newPhoneHint: They sign in with this number.
users.newRoleHint: A member or clan leader also needs a clan.
users.newPasswordNote: A temporary password is made for them and shown once after you create the account.
users.staffOnlySuperAdmin: Only the Super Admin can manage a Support account.
users.supportBody: Support can do everything on the platform except reset passwords. They are signed out and sign in again as Support.
users.supportBodyIs: This person is Support. Removing the role makes them a general user again.
users.supportFailed: That change could not be made. Only a general user with no clan can become Support.
users.leaderBody: Make this person a leader of a clan. They are signed out and sign in again as Clan Leader.
users.leaderBodyIs: This person leads their clan. Stepping them down makes them an ordinary member of the same clan.
users.leaderMakeConfirmPick: Make {name} a leader of the clan you chose?
users.leaderLast: This is the clan's only leader. Make someone else leader first.
users.leaderBlocked: This account is blocked. Unblock it first.
users.leaderFailed: That change could not be made.

profile.lede: Your details, how people can reach you, and the identity documents the platform checks.
profile.dateOfBirthHint: Your age is worked out from this.
profile.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
profile.phoneNote: You sign in with this number, so it can't be changed here.
profile.whatsappHint: If it is different from your phone number.
profile.socialHint: Your username, or a link to your page.
profile.errPhoto: Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF under 5 MB.
profile.noDocuments: You have not added a document yet.
profile.noDocumentsMember: No document has been added yet.
profile.docFileHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB.
profile.docExists: This document is already on your account.
profile.emptyBody: Add one so the platform can confirm who you are. It is seen only by you, the platform and your clan leader.
profile.docFinal: Once sent, a document stays on your account. If something is wrong with it, the platform turns it down and you add another.

kyc.title: Identity checks
kyc.lede: Approve or turn down the identity documents people send. An approved document is what lets someone join a clan and ask for donations.
kyc.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting. New documents appear here as soon as they are sent.
kyc.reasonPlaceholder: Reason, if you turn it down
kyc.errReason: Say why it was turned down.
kyc.errState: This document has already been decided. Refresh the page.
kyc.adminDecides: Approved by the platform, not by the clan
kyc.needTitle: Your identity is not confirmed yet
kyc.needForClan: Your identity has to be approved before you can join a clan.
kyc.needForRequest: Your identity has to be approved before you can ask for donations.
kyc.needHint: Add an identity document on your account page; the platform checks it.
kyc.mineBodyNone: Add an identity document so the platform can confirm who you are. You need an approved document before you can join a clan or ask for donations.
kyc.mineBodyPending: Your document is with the platform. You will be told as soon as it has been looked at.
kyc.mineBodyApproved: Your identity is confirmed. You can join a clan and ask for donations.
kyc.mineBodyRejected: Your document was not accepted. The reason is below — add another one and it will be looked at again.
kyc.bannerPending: Your identity check is under way
kyc.bannerBodyNone: You need an approved document before you can join a clan or ask for donations.
kyc.bannerBodyPending: You will be told as soon as it has been looked at.
kyc.bannerBodyRejected: Add another document and it will be looked at again.

savings.title: Savings groups
savings.lede: Save together with people you trust. Each round everyone pays the same amount, and one person receives the whole pot.
savings.empty: You are not in any savings group yet.
savings.emptyBody: Start one and share its code, or join a group with the code someone gave you.
savings.newLede: Set the amount and how often people pay. You get a code to share, and you approve everyone who asks to join.
savings.fStartDateHint: Each later round is due one week or one month after the one before.
savings.receivingHint: When it is your turn, members send your pot here. Give an account, a QR code, or both.
savings.fQrHint: A photo of your bank QR code.
savings.keepQr: Leave empty to keep your current QR code.
savings.errName: Give the group a name (at least 3 letters).
savings.errAmount: Enter the amount in kip, for example 100000.
savings.errStartDate: Choose today or a later date.
savings.errReceiving: Add an account name and number, or a QR code.
savings.errFile: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image under 5 MB.
savings.errSlipFile: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF under 5 MB.
savings.errState: This has changed since you opened the page. Reload and try again.
savings.errTermsLocked: People have already joined at this amount and frequency. To change them, cancel this group and start a new one.
savings.joinLede: Enter the code the organizer gave you.
savings.errCode: No group is taking members with this code. Check it with the organizer.
savings.errAlready: You are already in this group or waiting for approval.
savings.joinAbout: {organizer} organizes this group. {amount} {period}, {n} members so far.
savings.pendingBody: {organizer} has your request to join. You will get a notification when it is decided.
savings.inviteBody: Share this code or link. You approve everyone who asks.
savings.inviteBodyMember: Share this code with people who want to join. The organizer approves everyone.
savings.orderBody: Round 1 goes to the first person, and so on. The order is locked when the group starts.
savings.waitingStart: The organizer starts the group once everyone has joined. Until then the order may still change.
savings.startBody: {n} members, {rounds} rounds. Each round's pot is {pot}. Once started, nobody can join and the order cannot change.
savings.errTooFew: A group needs at least 2 members.
savings.errMissingReceiving: These members still need receiving details: {names}
savings.errStartPast: The first due date has passed. Edit the group and choose a new date.
savings.youReceive: This is your round. You receive {pot}.
savings.waitingCheck: Your slip was sent. Waiting for {name} to check it.
savings.fSlipHint: A photo or PDF of the bank confirmation.
savings.errDate: Enter the date you made the transfer.
savings.errSlip: Add a photo of the transfer slip.
savings.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the amount is wrong
savings.errReason: Say why, so they can fix it.
savings.rejectedMsg: They have been asked to send it again.
savings.errRemindedToday: A reminder was already sent today.
savings.feeNote: When this round is complete, the receiver owes a platform fee of {pct}% of the pot ({fee}).
savings.completedTitle: Every member has received their pot.
savings.swapBody: You can trade turns with someone who has not received any money yet. They have to accept, and everyone in the group is told.
savings.swapWaiting: You asked {name} to swap turns. Waiting for their answer.
savings.swapIncoming: {name} asks to swap turns: you would receive in round {theirs} ({theirDate}) instead of round {mine} ({myDate}).
savings.errSwap: This swap is no longer possible: one of you has already started receiving money.
savings.errSwapOpen: You already have a swap request waiting for an answer.
savings.swapMessagePlaceholder: For example: I need the money earlier for school fees.
